description: This file implements a PostgreSQL repository layer with functions for database interactions such as insert, update, delete, getById, list, upsert, and ledger balance management, utilizing connection pooling and tenant-specific filtering logic.

methods.name: requireEnv()
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables and throws an error if any are missing.

methods.name: buildWhere(filter = {}, opts = {})
methods.description: Constructs SQL WHERE clause components and values based on provided filters and options, enforcing tenant scope and optional company scope.

methods.name: insert(table, data, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Performs an INSERT operation into a specified table, adding tenant and audit information.

methods.name: update(table, id, patch, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Performs an UPDATE operation on a specified record, updating fields, and setting update timestamp and updater info.

methods.name: remove(table, id, { tenantId })
methods.description: Performs a DELETE operation (by tenant ID and record ID).

methods.name: getById(table, id, { tenantId })
methods.description: Retrieves a record by its ID, scoped to tenant.

methods.name: list(table, filter = {}, { tenantId, companyId, companyScoped = false } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves multiple records according to filter criteria, with tenant and optional company scoping.

methods.name: upsert(table, where, data, { tenantId, actorUserId })
methods.description: Performs an upsert operation: updates existing record matching 'where' or inserts if none exists.

methods.name: upsertLedgerBalance({ tenantId, companyId, accountId, entry })
methods.description: Updates or inserts ledger balance and transaction entries for a specific account and company, computing running balance.

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^async function list(table, filter = {}, { tenantId, companyId, companyScoped = false } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^async function update(table, id, patch, { tenantId, actorUserId }) {$/

ctags.name: upsert
ctags.pattern: /^async function upsert(table, where, data, { tenantId, actorUserId }) {$/

ctags.name: upsertLedgerBalance
ctags.pattern: /^async function upsertLedgerBalance({ tenantId, companyId, accountId, entry }) {$/
